newsitem.title: USA: Hudson Foods sees Q3 loss from charge.
newsitem.headline: Hudson Foods sees Q3 loss from charge.

text.p: Hudson Foods Inc said on Friday it expects a charge of $0.66 per share for the reorganization of the company's International Division to cause a net loss of $0.48 to $0.50 per share for the third quarter.
In addition, the company expects nine month earnings per share before inclusion of the charge of $0.68 to $0.70 per share and a profit of $0.02 to $0.04 per share after the charge.

The company concluded in a statement that it anticipates that it will not meet analysts' expectations before inclusion of the third quarter charge due to lower than expected market prices for its chicken products.
The First Call consensus estimate for the third quarter was $0.23 per share.
Hudson Foods is an integrated producer and marketer of poultry products, luncheon meats and egg products.
